description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.
